advancedArguments.name: masterDataType
advancedArguments.description: Specifies the master data type. If not provided, the value will be fetched using the getDefineMasterDateDetails API.

raw.description: Specifies the master data type. If not provided, the value will be fetched using the getDefineMasterDateDetails API.

advancedArguments.name: editKey
advancedArguments.description: Specifies the edit key for the data. If not provided, it will be retrieved using the getDefineMasterDateDetails API.

raw.description: Specifies the edit key for the data. If not provided, it will be retrieved using the getDefineMasterDateDetails API.

advancedArguments.name: id
advancedArguments.description: Specifies the ID of the data. If not provided, it will be retrieved using the getDefineMasterDateDetails API.

raw.description: Specifies the ID of the data. If not provided, it will be retrieved using the getDefineMasterDateDetails API.

advancedArguments.name: description
advancedArguments.description: Specifies the currency description of the data. If changed, the updated value will be used. If not provided, it will be fetched using the getDefineMasterDateDetails API.

raw.description: Specifies the currency description of the data. If changed, the updated value will be used. If not provided, it will be fetched using the getDefineMasterDateDetails API.

advancedArguments.name: amount
advancedArguments.description: Specifies the update amount value. If changed, the updated value will be used. If not provided, it will be fetched using the getDefineMasterDateDetails API.Ex:3000,20,20 etc..

raw.description: Specifies the update amount value. If changed, the updated value will be used. If not provided, it will be fetched using the getDefineMasterDateDetails API.Ex:3000,20,20 etc..
